topic: Changes in Solid Materials and Their Uses
key_concepts: Solids are objects that have their own size and shape.
Materials can be described by their shape, size, color, and texture.
Physical properties of materials determine their use.
Shaping changes the appearance of solid materials.
Shaping solid materials can make them useful.
Pressing or hammering changes solid materials.
Pressing or hammering can make solid materials useful.
A flat iron presses clothes to remove wrinkles.
Cutting changes solid materials and can make them useful.
Joining combines solid materials and can make them useful.
Cutting or tearing paper can create shapes such as triangles for banderitas.
Joining cut pieces can make a string of banderitas.
